title: Umthunzi Ongasemva Kwetrone
intro: Umi ngaphakathi kweenkundla zobukumkani bamandulo obunamandla, apho umlawuli onamandla ezivakalise njengothixo phezu kwabo bonke abantu. Ecaleni kwalo mlawuli kumi umkhonzi ozinikeleyo, ophathiswe amabhongo amakhulu obukumkani. Kunye, baceba baze bacebe, bengavumi ukuthobela izilumkiso zomthunywa othunyelwe ukuba abakhokele. Ungamtyhila ukuba ngubani lo mkhonzi uthembekileyo?
clues: Ndandihlala kubukumkani obunamandla obulawulwa ngumntu onamandla owayesithi unguThixo phezu kwabo bonke abantu.
Bendingumlungiseleli othembekileyo walo mlawuli, ndifezekisa yonke iminqweno nemiyalelo yakhe.
Xa isithunywa sika-Allah safika kwilizwe lethu sisibizela enyanisweni, mna nomlawuli wam sala ukumamela.
Ndayalelwa ukuba ndibase umlilo omkhulu ndize ndilungise izitena zodongwe ukuze kwakhiwe isakhiwo esikhulu.
Umlawuli wam wayefuna ukwakha isakhiwo esiphakamileyo kangangokuba sasinokufikelela emazulwini ngokwawo.
Ekugqibeleni, umlawuli wam, imikhosi yethu, kunye nam sakhukuliswa saza satshona ezinzulwini zolwandle.

outcome.label: Isiphumo
options: Uphakanyiswe waya kwindawo ekhuselekileyo kwibhotwe elihle kakhulu

arabic: أَسْبَـٰبَ ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ فَأَطَّلِعَ إِلَىٰٓ إِلَـٰهِ مُوسَىٰ وَإِنِّى لَأَظُنُّهُۥ كَـٰذِبًۭا ۚ وَكَذَٰلِكَ زُيِّنَ لِفِرْعَوْنَ سُوٓءُ عَمَلِهِۦ وَصُدَّ عَنِ ٱلسَّبِيلِ ۚ وَمَا كَيْدُ فِرْعَوْنَ إِلَّا فِى تَبَابٍۢ
verse: The ways into the heavens - so that I may look at the deity of Moses; but indeed, I think he is a liar." And thus was made attractive to Pharaoh the evil of his deed, and he was averted from the [right] way. And the plan of Pharaoh was not except in ruin. (40:37)
